notes: The GGUF holds the transformer only. The text encoder and the VAE are separate files the runtime loads beside it, so size_gb is the file, not the resident footprint of a run — with a bf16 text encoder that is another 17.5 GB, and which text encoder was used belongs in the result's args. bits is the file's bytes x 8 / 7,115,124,736 transformer parameters, so it sits above the nominal width of the quantization because the f32 and f16 tensors are in the file too. Community upload, not verified against a reference implementation.
